sources: CalEnviroScreen 4.0 (OEHHA, Oct 2021) — pollution burden percentile, diesel PM, asthma ED visits, ACS 2015-2019 race shares.
U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 5-Year 2015-2019, table B19013 — median household income.
Mapping Inequality, University of Richmond Digital Scholarship Lab (1937 Oakland HOLC residential-security map).
_meta.method: Oakland-area census tracts (2010 boundaries) classified by 1937 HOLC grade at tract centroid. Redlined = HOLC C ("Declining") or D ("Hazardous"); non-redlined = A ("Best") or B ("Still Desirable"). Tract-level values averaged, weighted by 2019 population.
